bio: My name is Paulina Alford and I am a Ruby on Rails developer since 2016. I started my career in Software Houses where I’ve been building Web Applications - usually from scratch, but sometimes joining in to what others have started. Although my career is mostly connected with Ruby on Rails, I also program in JavaScript.
During that time I delivered over 20 web applications developed from scratch and I was part of the team that implemented first Decidim platforms in Poland.

Later in ma career I was working for product companies, where I've learned a lot about scaling and optimizing code for handling a lot of data and high traffic. Big part of my work was around integrations with external APIs like Payment Providers (Stripe, Adyen, Molly), Google Calendar, Salesforce etc.
The highest value of every workplace for me were always people: if you take ownership you can create great product, but having great people with you will let you make it exceptional.
